summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Primal Origins / Echo single-page site. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (claim-spot create, idempotency by email, referral linkage, 422 invalid email, referral validation valid/invalid, contact success). Frontend: navbar (6 nav-links using lowercase testids), Echo dark section with 3 feature cards, Claim form generates ECHO-XXX-XXXXXX code and copy button works, Contact form submits + Sonner success toast shows, Topic Radix Select renders all 4 options, Footer company registration shows ACN 697 504 993, Terms & Privacy dialogs open with legal content, 'Book a Free Consultation' CTA present.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav link data-testid is lowercased (nav-link-home) — matches spec pattern nav-link-<label>. Confirm downstream consumers use same casing.
server.py referral endpoint currently returns 200 even for invalid codes with {valid:false}; acceptable per spec. Consider 404 if strictness desired.
Google Sheet webhook forwarding is intentionally skipped when GOOGLE_SHEET_WEBHOOK_URL is empty (MOCKED per request — expected).
seed_data_creation: Test-only signup rows inserted with TEST_ prefixed emails in beta_signups and contact_messages collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav testids are lowercase (nav-link-home, ...-echo, etc.). Radix Dialog opens via portal — offsetParent is null but content renders correctly. Sonner toast text: 'Message sent. Our team will respond promptly.' Referral code format verified: ECHO-<3-letter-prefix>-<6-hex>.
